description: This file defines Flask API endpoints for admin login, booking status updates, and customer tracking, including route handlers, authentication, and utility functions.

classes.name: AdminLogin
classes.description: API endpoint for admin login, returning authentication token.

classes.name: AdminBookingStatus
classes.description: API endpoint for updating booking status.

classes.name: TrackStatus
classes.description: API endpoint for customer to track booking status by ID or phone.

methods.name: _normalize_phone
methods.description: Normalizes phone number input by removing spaces/dashes, keeping leading +.

methods.name: _admin_tokens_from_env
methods.description: Retrieves admin tokens from environment variables.

methods.name: _issue_admin_token
methods.description: Generates an admin token based on username and environment secret.

methods.name: _require_admin_token
methods.description: Validates the presence and correctness of admin authorization token.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles admin login, verifies credentials, and issues token.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates booking status after admin token validation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves booking status by ID or phone number for customer tracking.
